mentions.note: Olympic runner and ex-Midland Junior Champion; finished outside the first hundred in the 1928 Southern at Shenfield
ten years ago (1927-28): won the 7 miles Cross-country Championship
old club champion; won the Macher Shield race twice
won inter-club cross country race c.1926
one-time cross-country champion; as a Sparkhill Harrier won the Midlands Everill Cup and ran in the 1924 Olympic Games; won Belgrave 10 miles Championship 1927 and 1928

share.d: Arthur Clark in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1934–1969: 7 mentions in 6 issues and 3 race results.
